loanEmi.name: Loan EMI
loanEmi.short: Monthly payment, total interest and a full repayment schedule.
loanEmi.seo.title: Loan EMI Calculator – Monthly Payment & Amortization
loanEmi.seo.description: Calculate your loan EMI, total interest and full amortization schedule instantly. Free, private, works offline.
loanEmi.explanation: EMI = P × r × (1 + r)ⁿ ÷ ((1 + r)ⁿ − 1), where P is the loan amount, r is the monthly interest rate (annual rate ÷ 12 ÷ 100) and n is the number of monthly payments. If the rate is 0, EMI is simply P ÷ n. Each month, interest is charged on the remaining balance and the rest of the EMI reduces the principal.
loanEmi.faq.1.a: An Equated Monthly Instalment is the fixed amount you pay every month until the loan is fully repaid. It covers both interest and principal.
loanEmi.faq.2.q: Why is most of my early EMI interest?
loanEmi.faq.2.a: Interest is charged on the outstanding balance, which is highest at the start. As you repay principal, the interest portion shrinks.
loanEmi.faq.3.q: Does this include fees or insurance?
loanEmi.faq.3.a: No. Processing fees, insurance and taxes vary by lender and are not included.
percentage.name: Percentage
percentage.short: Percent of a number, percent share and percent change.
percentage.mode: What do you want to find?
percentage.explain.change.up: Going from {x} to {y} is an increase of {r}%.
percentage.explain.change.down: Going from {x} to {y} is a decrease of {r}%.
percentage.seo.title: Percentage Calculator – Percent Of, Share and Change
percentage.seo.description: Work out X% of Y, what percent X is of Y, or the percent change between two numbers. Instant and free.
percentage.explanation: X% of Y = X ÷ 100 × Y. X as a percent of Y = X ÷ Y × 100. Percent change from X to Y = (Y − X) ÷ |X| × 100.
percentage.faq.1.q: How do I calculate a discount?
percentage.faq.1.a: Use “X% of Y” with the discount as X and the price as Y, then subtract the result from the price.
percentage.faq.2.q: Why can't I find the change from 0?
percentage.faq.2.a: Percent change divides by the starting value, and dividing by zero has no meaningful answer.
page.about.title: About
page.about.body: My Calcy Hub is a collection of fast, private calculators. Everything runs in your browser: nothing you type is sent anywhere.
page.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
page.privacy.body: My Calcy Hub has no accounts and no database. Your settings and recently used calculators are stored only in your browser's local storage, and you can clear them at any time.
page.terms.title: Terms
page.terms.body: My Calcy Hub is provided as is, without warranty of any kind. You are responsible for checking results before relying on them.
page.disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
page.disclaimer.body: Results are estimates for information only and are not financial advice. Consult a qualified professional before making financial decisions.

sip.name: SIP
sip.short: Grow a fixed monthly investment over time.
sip.seo.title: SIP Calculator – Monthly Investment Returns
sip.explanation: FV = A × ((1+i)ⁿ − 1) ÷ i × (1+i), where A is the monthly amount, i the monthly rate (annual ÷ 12 ÷ 100) and n the number of months. Payments are assumed at the start of each month.
sip.faq.1.a: No. The rate is your estimate; real market returns vary.
sip.faq.2.q: Why pay at the start of the month?
sip.faq.2.a: It is the common convention for SIPs, so each payment earns one extra month.
lumpsum.name: Lumpsum
lumpsum.short: What a one-time investment grows to.
lumpsum.seo.title: Lumpsum Investment Calculator
lumpsum.explanation: Future value = P × (1 + r)ᵗ with yearly compounding, where r is the annual rate and t the years.
lumpsum.faq.1.a: Use a realistic long-term average for the investment type.
lumpsum.faq.2.a: No. Use the Inflation calculator to see today's value.
cagr.name: CAGR
cagr.short: Average yearly growth between two values.
cagr.seo.title: CAGR Calculator – Compound Annual Growth Rate
cagr.explanation: CAGR = (end ÷ start)^(1 ÷ years) − 1. It is the steady yearly rate that turns the start value into the end value.
cagr.faq.1.q: Is CAGR the same as average return?
cagr.faq.1.a: No. CAGR smooths growth into one steady yearly rate.
cagr.faq.2.a: Yes, when the end value is lower than the start.
inflation.name: Inflation
inflation.short: Future cost of today's money, and its buying power.
inflation.seo.title: Inflation Calculator – Future Cost and Buying Power
inflation.explanation: Future cost = amount × (1 + rate)ᵗ. Buying power = amount ÷ (1 + rate)ᵗ.
inflation.faq.1.q: What inflation rate should I use?
inflation.faq.1.a: Use your country's recent average, often 2–7%.
inflation.faq.2.a: What today's amount will feel like in the future.
fd.name: Fixed deposit
fd.short: Maturity value of a bank fixed deposit.
fd.seo.title: FD Calculator – Fixed Deposit Maturity
fd.explanation: A = P × (1 + r ÷ 4)^(4t), compounded quarterly as most banks do.
fd.faq.1.a: No. Interest may be taxable where you live.
fd.faq.2.a: Most banks compound fixed deposits every quarter.
rd.name: Recurring deposit
rd.short: Maturity of a fixed monthly deposit.
rd.seo.title: RD Calculator – Recurring Deposit Maturity
rd.explanation: Each monthly deposit earns interest compounded quarterly until maturity; the results are added up.
rd.faq.1.a: At the start of each month.
rd.faq.2.a: No. Interest may be taxable where you live.
compound-interest.name: Compound interest
compound-interest.seo.title: Compound Interest Calculator
compound-interest.explanation: A = P × (1 + r ÷ k)^(k × t), where k is how many times a year interest is added.
compound-interest.faq.1.q: What is a good value for times per year?
compound-interest.faq.2.q: How is it different from simple interest?
compound-interest.faq.2.a: Interest is added to the balance, so it also earns interest.
simple-interest.name: Simple interest
simple-interest.short: Interest on the original amount only.
simple-interest.seo.title: Simple Interest Calculator
simple-interest.explanation: Interest = P × r × t ÷ 100. Interest is never added back to the balance.
simple-interest.faq.2.q: Can time be part of a year?
simple-interest.faq.2.a: Yes, for example 0.5 for six months.
gst.name: GST / VAT / sales tax
gst.short: Add tax to a price, or find the tax inside it.
gst.seo.title: GST, VAT and Sales Tax Calculator
gst.explanation: Tax added = amount × rate ÷ 100. If tax is already included: price before tax = amount ÷ (1 + rate ÷ 100).
gst.faq.1.a: Use “Total with tax added” for a price before tax; use the “included” values when the price already has tax.
gst.faq.2.q: Does it split CGST and SGST?
gst.faq.2.a: Each is half of the GST shown.
discount.name: Discount
discount.short: Final price after a percentage off.
discount.seo.title: Discount Calculator – Sale Price
discount.explanation: Saving = price × discount ÷ 100. Final price = price − saving.
discount.faq.1.a: Apply the second one to the already-discounted price.
discount.faq.2.a: No. Use the GST calculator on the final price.
length-converter.name: Length converter
length-converter.short: Kilometres, miles, feet, inches and more.
length-converter.seo.title: Length Converter – km, miles, feet, cm
length-converter.explanation: Each unit is converted to metres, then to the target unit.
length-converter.faq.1.q: How many km is a mile?
weight-converter.name: Weight converter
weight-converter.seo.title: Weight Converter – kg, lb, oz, g
weight-converter.explanation: Each unit is converted to kilograms, then to the target unit.
weight-converter.faq.1.q: How many pounds in a kilogram?
temperature-converter.name: Temperature converter
temperature-converter.seo.title: Temperature Converter – °C, °F, K
volume-converter.name: Volume converter
volume-converter.seo.title: Volume Converter – litres, gallons, cups
volume-converter.explanation: Each unit is converted to litres, then to the target unit.
volume-converter.faq.1.q: Are US and UK gallons the same?
volume-converter.faq.1.a: No. A UK gallon is about 4.546 L; a US gallon about 3.785 L.
area-converter.name: Area converter
area-converter.short: Square feet, metres, acres and hectares.
area-converter.seo.title: Area Converter – sq ft, sq m, acres
area-converter.explanation: Each unit is converted to square metres, then to the target unit.
speed-converter.name: Speed converter
speed-converter.seo.title: Speed Converter – km/h, mph, knots
speed-converter.explanation: Each unit is converted to metres per second, then to the target unit.
speed-converter.faq.1.q: How fast is 100 km/h in mph?
data-converter.name: Data size converter
data-converter.short: Bytes, MB, GB, TB and binary units.
data-converter.seo.title: Data Size Converter – MB, GB, TB, GiB
data-converter.explanation: kB, MB, GB use 1,000 steps; KiB, MiB, GiB use 1,024 steps.
data-converter.faq.1.q: Why does my drive show less space?
data-converter.faq.1.a: Drives are sold in GB (1,000) but computers often show GiB (1,024).
age.name: Age
age.short: Exact age in years, months and days.
age.seo.title: Age Calculator – Exact Age and Next Birthday
age.explanation: Age counts full years, then full months, then remaining days between the two dates.
age.faq.1.a: They count as 1 March in non-leap years.
date-difference.name: Date difference
date-difference.short: Days, weeks and weekdays between two dates.
date-difference.seo.title: Days Between Dates Calculator
date-difference.explanation: Counts days from the start date up to, but not including, the end date. Weekdays skip Saturday and Sunday.
date-difference.faq.1.a: No. Add one day if you need it included.
add-days.name: Add or subtract days
add-days.short: Find the date a number of days away.
add-days.seo.title: Add Days to a Date Calculator
add-days.explanation: Adds the number of days to the start date on the calendar; negative numbers go back.
add-days.faq.1.a: No, it counts every calendar day.
